message.content:
<summary>
Turn 16: Added clusterdata.datatypes.TaskEvent (Serializable) with fields timestamp/jobId/taskIndex/eventType, constant EVENT_SUBMIT=0, and a fromCsv parser reading task_events CSV fields (timestamp at idx0, job_id idx2, task_index idx3, event_type idx5).  
Turn 17: Added clusterdata.datatypes.JobEvent (Serializable) with fields timestamp/jobId/eventType, constant EVENT_FINISH=4, and fromCsv parser reading job_events CSV fields (timestamp idx0, job_id idx2, event_type idx3).  
Turn 18: Added clusterdata.io.GzipCsvSourceFunction<T>, a simple SourceFunction that reads a local file (optionally .gz via GZIPInputStream) line-by-line and parses each line using a provided Parser functional interface, skipping malformed/empty lines.  
Turn 19: Added clusterdata.io.LocalTextFileSink extending RichSinkFunction<String> that writes one string per line to a local file path (overwrites existing).  
Turn 20: Re-opened LongestSessionPerJob.java; still skeleton at that point.  
Turn 21: Replaced LongestSessionPerJob.java with full implementation: reads params task_input/job_input/output and sesssize (default 600 seconds), computes gapMicros=sesssize*1_000_000, builds streams using AppBase taskSourceOrTest/jobSourceOrTest with the new GzipCsvSourceFunction parsers, assigns event-time watermarks using forMonotonousTimestamps, filters task SUBMIT and job FINISH events, keys both by jobId, connects them, and uses a KeyedCoProcessFunction (LongestStageOnFinish) to count SUBMIT events into “stages” split by inactivity gap and emit (jobId, longestStageTaskCount) when a FINISH event-time timer fires. Output is mapped to “(jobId,count)” and written via sinkOrTest(LocalTextFileSink) with parallelism 1.  
Turn 22: Fixed a type bug in processElement2: emitted state is Boolean, not Long.  
Turn 23: Maven compile failed due to sinkOrTest returning SinkFunction<?> not SinkFunction<String> (type mismatch at addSink).  
Turn 24: Fixed compilation by casting the sinkOrTest result to SinkFunction<String> in addSink.  
Turn 25-26: Maven package succeeded; jar-with-dependencies produced in target/.  
Turn 27-28: Adjusted stage gap comparison from “> gapMicros” to “>= gapMicros” (10 minutes inactivity closes stage) and rebuilt successfully.  
Turn 29-30: Made TaskEvent.fromCsv more robust: task_index may be empty; now treated as -1 instead of rejecting the record. Rebuilt successfully.  </summary>
